creator: Alexander Terp
description:
A selection is re-placed when the window asks a pane to scroll, because that is when it knows the pane moved (a_2ADMeD8nM). A find's landing scrolls it from the other side: the core works out where the match is and writes the scroll onto the pane's own channel, so the window never hears about it and a selection made before a search sits over the wrong text until the next wheel notch.

Small, and narrow - it needs somebody to select text and then search the same pane without scrolling afterwards. The fix is a line rather than a design: the core already knows it scrolled, so a find that lands can say so, and the chrome asks where the pane is looking the way a wheel makes it.
title: 🔎 Landing on a match moves a pane without the window noticing
